item.text: {"ticker":"GOOGL","status":"success","report":"This report is for educational use only and is not financial advice. MCP returned a successful FCFF valuation for Alphabet Inc in USD. The model estimates value per share at 370.32 versus a market price of 382.97. Growth uses a three-stage 15-year path: revenue grows 18.12% next year, 17.04% in years 2-5, then fades toward 4.60% terminal growth. Margins start very high, with next-year operating margin at 46.00%, then converge to 35.70%. Reinvestment is driven by sales-to-capital of 3.55x in years 1-5 and 1.77x in years 6-10, meaning growth requires meaningful incremental capital even with strong operating cash generation. Cost of capital starts at 10.05% and fades to 9.63%; the terminal value is 7.98 trillion, with present value of terminal value at 1.93 trillion, a major part of total operating asset value. Data caveats: Yahoo Finance data can be missing, stale, or insufficient; rates are shown in percent; sales-to-capital is shown as a multiple; Damodaran reference data mapped GOOGL to Software (Internet), United States, 2026, with confidence 0.574."}
